note: Maps environment names to Content Understanding endpoints and their labeled-data storage. Add an entry here for each Foundry account (dev/test/prod). Scripts resolve -Environment against this file; -Endpoint always overrides it directly. labeledDataContainerUrl is where knowledgeSources[].kind=labeledData training data lives for that environment - copy-labeled-data.ps1 copies blobs between environments' containers, and promote-analyzer.ps1 rewrites analyzer.json's containerUrl to match the target environment at deploy time.
